theorem oj_t1 (a b : Nat) : a + b = b + a := by
  rw [Nat.add_comm]

theorem oj_t2 (a b c : Nat) : a + (b + c) = (a + b) + c := by
  rw [Nat.add_assoc]

theorem oj_t3 (n : Nat) : 0 + n = n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => simp

theorem oj_t4 (a : Nat) : a + 0 = a := by
  have h : a + 0 = a := by
    simp
  exact h

theorem oj_t5 (a b : Nat) : a + b = b + a := by
  exact oj_nonexistent_lemma
  rw [Nat.add_comm]

theorem oj_t6 (a b : Nat) : a + b = b + a := by
  have h : a = a := rfl
  exact Nat.mul_comm a b
  rw [Nat.add_comm]

theorem oj_t7 (a b : Nat) : a + b = b + a := by
  have h : a = a := rfl

theorem oj_t8 (a b : Nat) : a + b = b + a := by

theorem oj_t9 (a b : Nat) : a + b = b + a := by
  rw [Nat.add_comm

theorem oj_t10 (a b c : Nat) : a + b + c = c + b + a := by
  rw [Nat.add_comm a b]
  rw [Nat.add_assoc]
